body.purpose: Carries explanations, summaries, and ordinary interface text.

label.purpose: Marks compact structural sections and metadata.

control.purpose: Keeps operational actions direct and visibly actionable.

shadows.name: drawer-separation
shadows.purpose: Separates the off-canvas detail pane from the queue.

shadows.name: message-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts transient feedback above the workspace.

shadows.name: selection-inset
shadows.purpose: Marks the selected record without creating a card.

motion.name: detail-enter
motion.purpose: Moves the intermediate-width detail drawer into view; disabled for reduced motion and on phone layouts.

components.name: Primary Decision Button
components.description: The single affirmative action in the current decision context.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--blue); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--blue); color: #fff; font: 700 1rem/1.45 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .48; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A neutral control for reversible or supporting actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 10px 16px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: 700 1rem/1.45 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f8fafc; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--blue-soft); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: A visually secondary rejection or archival action.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 10px 16px; background: #fff; color: var(--danger); font: 700 1rem/1.45 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #fff7f6; border-color: var(--danger); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--danger); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { background: #feeceb; }

components.name: Credential Field
components.description: The standard engine text or selection control.
components.html: <input class="ds-field" type="password" placeholder="Admin token" aria-label="Admin token">
components.css: .ds-field { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: 400 1rem/1.45 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--muted); } .ds-field:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Collection Navigation Item
components.description: A rail item pairing a work collection with its count.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; padding: 11px 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--body); font: 400 1rem/1.45 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item small { color: var(--muted); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #f8fafc; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="true"] { background: #fff; color: var(--blue); font-weight: 750; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Queue Record
components.description: A ruled comparison row with selection, status, score, and disclosure.
components.css: .ds-queue-row { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(180px,1fr) 110px 92px 22px; gap: 14px; align-items: center; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 17px 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 400 1rem/1.45 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-business strong, .ds-business small { display: block; } .ds-business small { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; } .ds-status { color: var(--body); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-score { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-score b { font-size: 18px; } .ds-queue-row:hover, .ds-queue-row[aria-selected="true"] { background: #fff; } .ds-queue-row[aria-selected="true"] { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 var(--blue); padding-left: 14px; } .ds-queue-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A compact indicator for the current record state.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--blue-soft); color: var(--blue); font: 750 12px/1.45 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The NEPAR Demo Engine is a quiet, exacting work surface: part queue, part case file, part approval ledger. Its visual authority comes from disciplined columns, archival divider lines, restrained status color, and a single action blue that makes the next decision unmistakable.

The system is dense enough for repeated operational use without feeling compressed. It favors explicit facts and visible state over decoration, matching NEPAR's technically confident, precise, and approachable character. Generated customer demos may adopt their own visual worlds; they are work products shown inside this system and must not donate their theme tokens to the engine shell.
keyCharacteristics: Three-pane desktop workspace with collection rail, queue, and selected-record detail.
Cool, near-white tonal layering separated by fine archival rules.
One action blue for selection, focus, primary action, and compact status emphasis.
Direct Croatian operational copy, numeric alignment, and explicit human approval states.
Responsive detail drawer that becomes the focused task surface on narrow screens.

rules.name: The One Decision Color Rule
rules.body: Decision Blue carries selection, focus, status emphasis, and primary action; do not introduce another competing positive accent.

rules.name: The Demo-Is-an-Artifact Rule
rules.body: A generated demo's palette belongs to the previewed customer site, not to the engine chrome.

rules.name: The Ledger Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracking belongs to compact structural labels, never to paragraphs, record names, or primary actions.

rules.name: The Selection-to-Detail Rule
rules.body: On wide screens, queue and case file remain visible together; on narrow screens, the case file becomes the focused layer and provides a clear return action.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain flat at rest; elevation appears only when an element physically overlaps another layer or communicates transient feedback.

rules.name: The Rounded-Control Rule
rules.body: Round the things people touch; keep the information architecture rectilinear.

dos: Do keep the current record, its evidence, and its decision actions in one continuous case-file reading order.
Do reserve Decision Blue for focus, selection, status emphasis, and the single primary action.
Do use rules and tonal surfaces to organize dense data before adding elevation.
Do preserve 44px minimum controls, visible focus, keyboard dismissal, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep generated demo visuals isolated inside preview media or dedicated demo routes.
donts: Don't turn the operations ledger into a generic KPI dashboard or a grid of interchangeable cards.
Don't import a customer's demo accent, typography, or shape language into the engine shell.
Don't use cyan or red as competing primary-action colors.
Don't hide an approval prerequisite; disabled actions must retain a concise explanation.
Don't add decorative gradients, glass effects, or ambient shadows to resting workspace surfaces.
